name: Austral-Holm
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by tectonic rift valleys. Farther poleward, past towering mountain ranges, the silence feels older than the soil.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
pirate hideout changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on water, medicinal compounds and platinum are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
